{{Top|leg}}
The '''Bakuran Honor Guard''' were an organization based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. They wore violet doublets and were used to guard the entrances of the [[Bakuran Senate Chamber]] and the tram station in the [[Great Hall (Bakura)|Great Hall]] of the [[Bakur Memorial Building]].
